name: enzyme-effects
label: Enzyme and transporter effects
description: What a drug does to an enzyme or transporter. A drug can be several of these at once for different enzymes, and substrate-plus-inhibitor of the same one.

terms.label: Substrate
terms.note: Cleared by it. Inhibitors of that enzyme raise this drug's exposure.

terms.label: Inhibitor
terms.note: Raises exposure of other substrates of that enzyme.

terms.label: Inducer
terms.note: Lowers exposure of other substrates. Onset and offset take days to weeks, unlike inhibition.
